project.title: NIGHT SIGNAL
project.headline: One lamp. One horizon. One hit.

concept.mood: A signal arriving from somewhere cold
references: the first 8 bars of a club before the room fills
concept.narrative: The show is a transmission. It starts with one lamp and a hum, builds a silhouette out of side light, and answers the drop with a single horizon. Nothing is decorative: every look is either a signal, a silhouette or a cut to black.
concept.statement: The show is designed before the lights go down.
rules: One silhouette, one horizon, one hit. A look may repeat; a gesture may not.
No fixture points below the front-row eyeline. The audience is never the target.
The drop is the only white frame in the show.
If the rig cannot carry the idea, the idea changes — not the safety case.
